name: Mt. Batulao
description: Known for its rolling open slopes and scenic 360-degree ridge trails.

name: Mt. Daraitan
description: Features rugged limestone trails and a magnificent view of the Tinipak River.

name: Mt. Maculot
description: Famous for the Rockies rock formation overlooking Taal Lake.

name: Mt. Ulap
description: Pine forests, grassland ridges, and iconic sea-of-clouds vistas.

name: Mt. Pulag
description: The highest peak in Luzon, celebrated for its dwarf bamboo slopes.

name: Mt. Manabu
description: Beginner-friendly trail with lush forest cover and a garden peak.

name: Mt. Pinatubo
description: Off-road 4x4 ride followed by a trek to a majestic crater lake.

name: Mt. Talamitam
description: Open grassy slopes ideal for day hikes and sunset viewing.

name: Mt. Pico de Loro
description: Distinctive monolith peak offering views of the South China Sea.

name: Mt. Daguldol
description: Combines a coastal beach jump-off with a scenic forest summit.

name: Mt. Tapulao
description: Pine-tree-lined trail with cool mountain temperatures.

name: Mt. Arayat
description: Extinct stratovolcano rising above the Central Luzon plains.

name: Mt. Kulis
description: Popular camping spot known for sea-of-clouds morning view decks.

name: Mt. Kalisungan
description: Panoramic view of Laguna's seven lakes from the grassy summit.

name: Mt. Cristobal
description: Dense mossy forests and intriguing volcanic crater trails.
